method: Prime actually read original 498 English and 498 Chinese cue texts in full sequential chunks; this script packages authored issues, no automatic translation inference

pairs.english: I’m Al Brooks.
pairs.chinese: 你好，我是阿尔·布鲁克斯

pairs.english: Thank you for watching the Brooks Trading Course.
pairs.chinese: 欢迎观看布鲁克斯交易课程

pairs.english: This is the final video on chart basics and price action.
pairs.chinese: 这是图表基础和价格行为系列的最后一节课

pairs.english: I will be talking about candlestick patterns, I will talk about...
pairs.chinese: 首先我会讲为什么蜡烛图形态没有用

issues.comment: ZH intro already asserts patterns are useless; EN only announces the topic. The stronger claim is made later (cue 175: patterns alone are useless).

pairs.english: ..what traders talk about, and finally I will talk some about indicators.
pairs.chinese: 我还会谈到职业交易员们平时真正会聊的内容 最后我会讲一讲指标

pairs.english: I think one of the unfortunate things that beginners see...
pairs.chinese: 我认为新手遇到的不幸之一是

pairs.english: ..when they start out is a collection of ads and claims on the Internet
pairs.chinese: 他们刚开始时， 会在网上看到一堆广告和声明

pairs.english: and in books and magazines that make it sound like if you simply memorize...
pairs.chinese: 以及书籍和杂志上写的

pairs.english: ..a handful of candlestick patterns, you’re going to get rich.
pairs.chinese: 只需要记住一些简单的蜡烛图形态， 就能快速致富

pairs.english: And it’s really deceiving, because there’s nothing easy in trading.
pairs.chinese: 这真的很具有欺骗性，交易怎么可能那么容易？

pairs.english: You’re competing against the smartest people in the world who are working...
pairs.chinese: 你在与世界上最聪明的人竞争， 他们工作极其努力

pairs.english: ..extremely hard, and they are not going to give up their money easily.
pairs.chinese: 他们不会轻易地放弃他们的钱

pairs.english: So if you see ads like this that tell you that you can make...
pairs.chinese: 所以如果你看到这样的广告

pairs.english: ..an incredible amount of money with minimum work – where for example,
pairs.chinese: 告诉你，可以通过很少的工作赚到大量的钱

pairs.english: this one says you can turn $250 into $34,000 completely on autopilot.
pairs.chinese: 比如这个广告说， 你可以自动地把250美元变成34,000美元

pairs.english: It’s really tempting.
pairs.chinese: 确实很诱人

pairs.english: Everyone starting out is looking for protection.
pairs.chinese: 每个新手都在寻找保护

pairs.english: They’re afraid of losing their money.
pairs.chinese: 他们害怕亏钱

pairs.english: They’re looking for someone who’s going to take care of them.
pairs.chinese: 他们在寻找会照顾他们的人

pairs.english: But nobody’s going to take care of them.
pairs.chinese: 但没有人会照顾他们

pairs.english: They’re looking for some easy way to make money...
pairs.chinese: 他们在寻找一些容易赚钱的方法

pairs.english: ..that’s guaranteed to not lose money.
pairs.chinese: “保证”不会亏钱的方法

pairs.english: And all of the ads imply that all you have to do is memorize...
pairs.chinese: 所有的广告都暗示你

pairs.english: ..a few candlestick patterns and they’ll work all the time,
pairs.chinese: 只需要记住几个蜡烛图形态 它们永远有效

pairs.english: or they’ll work 90% of the time, and you’ll soon be rich...
pairs.chinese: 你很快就会变得富有

issues.comment: The 90% claim attributed to ads is missing in ZH.

pairs.english: ..like everybody else, like Warren Buffett.
pairs.chinese: 像沃伦·巴菲特一样成功

pairs.english: But that’s not real, it’s just not real.
pairs.chinese: 但这不是真的，这根本不现实

pairs.english: It’s misleading.
pairs.chinese: 完全是误导

pairs.english: So whenever you see anything like this, just ignore it.
pairs.chinese: 所以，当你看到这样的东西，忽略它

pairs.english: Move on to something else.
pairs.chinese: 去学更有用的东西

pairs.english: Now you correctly believe that there are institutions that make a lot of money.
pairs.chinese: 你知道事实是，有一些机构赚了很多钱

pairs.english: There are high frequency trading firms (HFT firms), hedge funds, Goldman Sachs.
pairs.chinese: 高频交易公司、对冲基金、高盛

pairs.english: Most of the firms out there making a lot of money...
pairs.chinese: 大多数赚钱的公司

pairs.english: ..are not making them based upon candlestick patterns.
pairs.chinese: 并不是基于蜡烛图形态赚到这些钱的

pairs.english: And if candlestick patterns were the key to wealth,
pairs.chinese: 如果蜡烛图形态是致富的关键

pairs.english: everyone would be using them to make money.
pairs.chinese: 每个人都会用它们赚钱，世界上就没有穷人了

issues.comment: ZH adds a remark not spoken.

pairs.english: But that’s not the reality.
pairs.chinese: 但这不现实

pairs.english: Lots of successful day traders talk about their trades.
pairs.chinese: 当成功的日内交易者讲解他们的交易

pairs.english: For example, if you watch Fast Money, the television show on CNBC,
pairs.chinese: 例如，CNBC的电视节目《快钱》

pairs.english: you’ll listen to the traders talk constantly about trends,
pairs.chinese: 你会听到交易员们不断谈论趋势

pairs.english: channels, prior highs, prior lows, support and resistance.
pairs.chinese: 他们谈论通道，之前的高点， 之前的低点，支撑和阻力

pairs.english: And you’ll never hear them say anything about a particular candlestick pattern.
pairs.chinese: 你不会听他们讲某个特定的蜡烛图形态

pairs.english: Like “Oh I sold because of a dark cloud cover...
pairs.chinese: 比如“哦！我看到了“乌云盖顶”形态

pairs.english: ..or shooting star or Harami pattern.”
pairs.chinese: “射击之星”形态或“母子线”形态， 所以我要做空！“

pairs.english: They don’t talk about that because that is such a tiny part...
pairs.chinese: 他们不会去讲这些， 因为这些只是交易中的一小部分

pairs.english: ..of trading that it’s not going to make you any money.
pairs.chinese: 它们不是赚钱的关键

pairs.english: You have to learn far more than that to be successful.
pairs.chinese: 你需要学习更多更懂的知识才能成功

pairs.english: Now look at this.
pairs.chinese: 看这张图

pairs.english: Here’s a candlestick bottom.
pairs.chinese: 这里是一个蜡烛图所谓的“底部形态”

pairs.english: The market’s going down, tries to bottom, tries to bottom again.
pairs.chinese: 市场下跌，尝试筑底，再次尝试筑底

pairs.english: Can you make money from this candlestick pattern? Of course you can.
pairs.chinese: 你能从这个蜡烛图形态中赚钱吗？当然可以

pairs.english: The way to do it is you don’t buy.
pairs.chinese: 方法就是：不要买入做多

pairs.english: You wait for a few bars.
pairs.chinese: 等待几根K线

pairs.english: Then you sell where the bulls will get out.
pairs.chinese: 然后你在多头离场的地方卖出做空

pairs.english: The bulls are trying to buy a bottom.
pairs.chinese: 多头试图在底部买入做反转

pairs.english: Trends are resistant to change; they’re probably going to continue.
pairs.chinese: 然而趋势是抗拒改变的；它们可能会继续下去

pairs.english: The bulls who buy here are going to get trapped and lose money,
pairs.chinese: 在这里买入的多头会被套住，他们会亏钱

pairs.english: so rather than buy here, look to sell...
pairs.chinese: 所以不要在这里买入

pairs.english: ..where they’ll get out, where they’ll get stopped out.
pairs.chinese: 而是在多头会止损的地方，寻找做空的机会

pairs.english: So yes, you can make money trading a candlestick pattern doing the opposite...
pairs.chinese: 所以是的，你可以反其道而行之

pairs.english: ..of what conventional candlestick pattern teaches you to do.
pairs.chinese: 做与传统蜡烛图形态相反的事情

pairs.english: Look at this.
pairs.chinese: 看这个

pairs.english: Here we have a bearish engulfing top on the daily chart.
pairs.chinese: 这里，日线图上有一个“空头吞噬”形态 (注: Al Brooks也讲吞噬线，但不是形态，需要结合背景)

issues.comment: Parenthetical note is the translator's, not the lecturer's; must not be quoted as course content.

pairs.english: The textbooks would tell you, “Ah, this bar traded above the high...
pairs.chinese: 教科书会告诉你，“啊， 这根K线高于前一根K线的高点

pairs.english: ..of that bar and then it closed on its low,
pairs.chinese: 低于前一根K线的低点

issues.comment: EN describes the close (on its low); ZH says it traded below the prior bar's low. Check chart frames around 240-253 s.

pairs.english: and it’s a big bear bar closing on its low – it’s a short. It’s a short.”
pairs.chinese: 它是一根收于低点的大阴线—— 它是一个卖出信号。”

pairs.english: Well, the risk is not all that great.
pairs.chinese: 嗯，风险不是那么大

pairs.english: It’s to this point.
pairs.chinese: 止损距离比较小

issues.comment: EN points to a chart level for the risk; ZH paraphrases as 'stop is small'.

pairs.english: The reward, maybe we come all the way down here.
pairs.chinese: 潜在利润空间呢？ 假如一路跌到这里

pairs.english: That’s good too.
pairs.chinese: 那是很不错的利润

pairs.english: So, great risk/reward.
pairs.chinese: 所以，盈亏比很高

pairs.english: However, what about probability? 80% of reversal attempts fail.
pairs.chinese: 然而，概率呢？80%的反转尝试都会失败

pairs.english: So this failed, this failed, this failed, this failed, this failed.
pairs.chinese: 这个失败了，这个失败了，这个失败了， 这个失败了，这个失败了

pairs.english: Failed.
pairs.chinese: 所有反转的尝试，全都失败

issues.comment: EN only says 'Failed' for a pointed chart example, ZH expands 'all reversal attempts failed'; restrict to these selected marked examples.

pairs.english: This one looks better than the others, but is it going to succeed?
pairs.chinese: 这个看起来比其他的好，但它会成功吗？

pairs.english: No. Whenever you see a top, you have to expect...
pairs.chinese: 大概率不会。每当你在强上涨趋势中 看到一个“顶部”

issues.comment: ZH adds 'in a strong bull trend'; plausible from the chart but not spoken.

pairs.english: ..that the top will fail and become a bull flag.
pairs.chinese: 你必须预期筑顶会失败，并成为一个牛旗

pairs.english: Don’t be too quick to sell a top.
pairs.chinese: 不要急着去摸顶做空

pairs.english: Instead, you have a better chance of making money if you wait a few bars
pairs.chinese: 相反，如果你等待几根K线 等待反转失败并成为牛旗

pairs.english: for the top to fail and become a bull flag and then buy as the trend resumes up.
pairs.chinese: 然后在趋势恢复上涨时买入做多， 你有更高的概率赚钱

pairs.english: Look at this.
pairs.chinese: 看这张图

pairs.english: Here we have a bullish engulfing bar.
pairs.chinese: 这里有“多头吞噬”形态

pairs.english: It traded below the lows of all of these bars...
pairs.chinese: 它的低点低于前面这些K线的低点

pairs.english: ..and then reversed up strongly and closed on its high.
pairs.chinese: 然后强烈反转并收在高位

pairs.english: But you need context.
pairs.chinese: 但你需要看背景

pairs.english: Context means you have to look at all the bars to the left,
pairs.chinese: 背景意味着看左边的所有K线

pairs.english: and they have to support your trade.
pairs.chinese: 它们必须支持你的交易

pairs.english: Now look at these bars to the left.
pairs.chinese: 然而看看左边的这些K线

pairs.english: A very Tight Bear Channel with very little in terms of pullbacks along the way.
pairs.chinese: 一个窄的下降通道， 一路下来几乎没有反弹

pairs.english: What is the probability that the first reversal up is going...
pairs.chinese: 第一次向上反转就成功 形成上涨趋势的概率有多少？

pairs.english: ..to lead to a bull trend? The probability is very low,
pairs.chinese: 概率非常低

pairs.english: yet you have a great-looking candlestick pattern.
pairs.chinese: 尽管你有一个看起来很好的蜡烛图形态

pairs.english: But the candlestick pattern alone is not enough.
pairs.chinese: 但单靠蜡烛图形态是不够的

pairs.english: It has to be in a context that makes sense, and this does not make sense.
pairs.chinese: 它必须处在一个合理的背景下， 这里的背景不支持反转

pairs.english: This is a low probability trade.
pairs.chinese: 这是一笔低概率交易

pairs.english: So what do you do? Well, you know the candlestick guys are buying,
pairs.chinese: 那应该怎么办呢？你知道有些人会根据 蜡烛图形态买入

pairs.english: betting on the trend reversal, but the smart guys are saying...
pairs.chinese: 押注趋势反转，但聪明人会说：

pairs.english: ..“Ah, this is a pullback in a bear trend, and therefore it’ll fail...
pairs.chinese: “啊，这是下降趋势中的一次反弹， 大概率会失败

pairs.english: ..and become a bear flag.” What they do is they don’t buy here;
pairs.chinese: 并形成熊旗。”于是他们不在这里买入

pairs.english: they place a sell stop to go short below the bear bar that followed it,
pairs.chinese: 他们在跟随的阴线下方 挂一个突破卖单做空

pairs.english: betting that, like most reversals, this one will fail...
pairs.chinese: 押注像大多数反转一样，这次也会失败

pairs.english: ..and the bear trend will continue.
pairs.chinese: 下降趋势会继续

pairs.english: Markets have inertia.
pairs.chinese: 市场具有惯性

pairs.english: That means they are resistant to change, and there’s an 80% chance...
pairs.chinese: 这意味着它们抗拒改变，有80%的几率

pairs.english: ..that they’ll continue doing what they have been doing.
pairs.chinese: 它们会继续做它们一直在做的事情

pairs.english: So for example, if you want to know what the bars to the right look like,
pairs.chinese: 所以如果你想知道右边的K线是什么样的

pairs.english: the ones that you don’t see yet, look to the left.
pairs.chinese: 看看左边

pairs.english: If we’re in a bear trend, chances are we’re going to continue in a bear trend.
pairs.chinese: 如果市场处于下降趋势中， 很有可能会继续下跌

pairs.english: If we’re in a Trading Range, chances are we’ll continue in a Trading Range.
pairs.chinese: 如果市场处于震荡区间中， 很有可能会继续震荡

issues.comment: Rendered 震荡区间 throughout (cues 109,146,148,155,178,302,367,369,389). Many Brooks Chinese materials use 交易区间; canonical choice must follow the abu-1a..2c glossary.

pairs.english: There’s much more to a bottom than simply a candlestick pattern.
pairs.chinese: 底部反转不是一个蜡烛图形态那么简单的

pairs.english: So if you’re in a bear trend, you make more money expecting reversals to fail.
pairs.chinese: 如果市场处于下降趋势中， 你会通过押注反转失败赚更多的钱

pairs.english: Y’know we had lots of reversals here – here, here, here.
pairs.chinese: 你知道这里有很多反转的尝试—— 这里，这里，这里

pairs.english: We tried to reverse here and here, here – most reversals are going to fail.
pairs.chinese: 在这里和这里，试图反转 但大多数反转会失败

pairs.english: Every one of those reversals is minor.
pairs.chinese: 每一个都是小反转

pairs.english: They are not Major Trend Reversals.
pairs.chinese: 不是大趋势反转

issues.comment: Inconsistent: 大趋势反转 (cue 115) vs 大反转 (cues 144, 239, 306, 382). Pick one canonical term.

pairs.english: They are not going to change a bear trend into a bull trend.
pairs.chinese: 它们不会将下降趋势变为上涨趋势

pairs.english: They’re going to change a bear trend into a bear flag,
pairs.chinese: 它们会将下降趋势变为熊旗

pairs.english: and then the bear flag will lead to a resumption of the bear trend.
pairs.chinese: 然后熊旗会让下降趋势延续下去

pairs.english: My 80% rule, inertia.
pairs.chinese: 这就是我的“80%规则”：惯性

pairs.english: When the market’s in a trend, 80% of reversal attempts will fail.
pairs.chinese: 当市场处于趋势中时，80%的反转尝试会失败

pairs.english: They’re minor reversals and they become bear flags,
pairs.chinese: 它们是小反转，是熊旗

pairs.english: and they lead to resumption of the trend down.
pairs.chinese: 下降趋势延续

pairs.english: So for example, here we’re trying to reverse up.
pairs.chinese: 例如，这里试图向上反转

pairs.english: We have a small Double Bottom.
pairs.chinese: 有一个小的双底

pairs.english: Am I going to buy that bar? No.
pairs.chinese: 我会在那根K线做多吗？不会

pairs.english: If anything, I’m going to place a limit order to sell the high of the bar.
pairs.chinese: 如果要做的话，我更愿意在它的高点 挂一个限价卖单去做空

pairs.english: Same here.
pairs.chinese: 这里也是一样

pairs.english: Here’s a bull bar closing on its high.
pairs.chinese: 收在高位的阳线

pairs.english: Am I going to buy that close? No.
pairs.chinese: 我会买它的收盘吗？不

pairs.english: If anything, I’m going to place a market order to sell as soon as I see...
pairs.chinese: 如果要做的话，我会在看到大阳线试图向上反转时

pairs.english: ..that big bull bar attempting to reverse up, because I know the math...
pairs.chinese: 立刻市价做空，因为数学和概率告诉我

pairs.english: ..is it’s more likely to lead to resumption down.
pairs.chinese: 趋势更有可能延续，市场会继续下跌

pairs.english: And that’s true all the way down.
pairs.chinese: 一路上都是如此

pairs.english: Every one of the reversal attempts,
pairs.chinese: 每一个反转尝试

pairs.english: I’m viewing as a bear flag, and I’m looking to sell.
pairs.chinese: 我都看作是熊旗，我在寻找做空机会

pairs.english: Bulls finally got their bounce.
pairs.chinese: 多头终于等到市场反弹了

pairs.english: The bulls who have been buying all the way down finally made money,
pairs.chinese: 那些一路做多的多头终于赚钱了

pairs.english: but they lost money on all the other prior attempts.
pairs.chinese: 但他们在之前的所有尝试中都亏了钱

pairs.english: And what they make here will probably not be enough...
pairs.chinese: 他们在这里赚到的钱

pairs.english: ..to offset their prior losses.
pairs.chinese: 不足以弥补之前的损失

issues.comment: EN cue139–140: profit 'will probably not be enough' to offset losses; ZH states definitely insufficient. Restore 可能不足以弥补.

pairs.english: And even this is only a minor reversal.
pairs.chinese: 而且就连这一次反弹，也是一次小反转

pairs.english: When the channel is this tight, you might bounce for 10 or 20 bars,
pairs.chinese: 非常窄的下降通道，可能会反弹10根20根K线

pairs.english: but the odds are you’re going to come back down and test this low.
pairs.chinese: 但大概率还会跌回去，测试前期的低点

pairs.english: At that point you might get a major reversal,
pairs.chinese: 然后才有可能开始大反转

pairs.english: but all these reversals, including this one, is probably minor.
pairs.chinese: 在此之前，所有这些反转， 包括它，基本都是小反转

pairs.english: Now, my 80% rule also applies to Trading Ranges.
pairs.chinese: 我的“80%规则”也适用于震荡区间

pairs.english: In a trend, 80% of reversal attempts fail.
pairs.chinese: 在趋势中，80%的反转尝试都会失败

pairs.english: In a Trading Range, 80% of attempts to break out into a trend will fail.
pairs.chinese: 在震荡区间中，80%的突破尝试会失败

pairs.english: So we tried to go to a new high but reversed down.
pairs.chinese: 试图创新高，但反转向下

pairs.english: A new low, reversed up.
pairs.chinese: 新的低点，反转向上

pairs.english: New low, reversed up.
pairs.chinese: 新的低点，反转向上

pairs.english: New high, reversed down.
pairs.chinese: 新的高点，反转向下

pairs.english: New low, reversed up.
pairs.chinese: 新的低点，反转向上

pairs.english: New high, reversed down.
pairs.chinese: 新的高点，反转向下

pairs.english: If you see a market having a lot of Trading Range price action,
pairs.chinese: 如果你看到市场有很多震荡区间的价格行为

pairs.english: don’t get excited when it breaks to the downside.
pairs.chinese: 当它向下突破时不要激动

pairs.english: You have to assume the downside breakout will fail.
pairs.chinese: 你必须假设向下突破会失败

pairs.english: And don’t get excited when it breaks to the upside.
pairs.chinese: 当它向上突破时也不要激动

pairs.english: Even when it’s breaking strongly to the upside like this,
pairs.chinese: 即使像这样，看上去非常强劲

pairs.english: the odds are that it will fail, at least pull back a little.
pairs.chinese: 大概率突破会失败，至少会稍微回调

pairs.english: Here it pulled back all the way to a new low.
pairs.chinese: 这里它下跌到一个新的低点

pairs.english: Trading is difficult to do.
pairs.chinese: 交易是很难的

pairs.english: I’ve been trading for 30 years, and it’s still difficult,
pairs.chinese: 我已经交易了30年，仍然不简单

pairs.english: but I enjoy doing it and I’m very peaceful when I do it.
pairs.chinese: 但我喜欢交易，我在交易的时候非常平静

pairs.english: When traders start out, they quickly learn that they lose money.
pairs.chinese: 当交易者刚开始时，很快就会发现他们在亏钱

pairs.english: No matter how hard they try to trade really well, no matter how much...
pairs.chinese: 无论他们多么努力地尝试，

pairs.english: ..they know about candlestick patterns, they’re losing money.
pairs.chinese: 无论他们学了多少蜡烛图形态，他们都在亏钱

pairs.english: So they realize they’re missing something.
pairs.chinese: 所以他们意识到他们缺乏一些东西

pairs.english: For example, here.
pairs.chinese: 例如，这里

pairs.english: A sell, a sell, but the market keeps going up.
pairs.chinese: 下跌，下跌，但市场继续上涨

issues.comment: EN refers to sell signals that failed while the market kept rising; ZH says 'falling, falling'.

pairs.english: What they’re missing is understanding context.
pairs.chinese: 他们缺乏的东西是：理解背景

pairs.english: Context means all of the bars to the left.
pairs.chinese: 背景意味着左边的所有K线

pairs.english: And what the market has been doing prior to the current bar
pairs.chinese: 左边的背景

pairs.english: is far more important than what the current bar looks like.
pairs.chinese: 比当前的这根K线重要得多

pairs.english: Candlestick patterns alone are useless.
pairs.chinese: 单靠蜡烛图形态是没用的

pairs.english: If anything, when you’re starting out, you’ll lose money...
pairs.chinese: 新手交易者刚开始时不断地亏钱

pairs.english: ..because you’ll constantly be betting that trends will reverse
pairs.chinese: 因为你不断地押注趋势会反转

pairs.english: and you’ll constantly be betting that Trading Ranges will break out –
pairs.chinese: 不断地押注震荡区间会突破

pairs.english: and 80% of the time, you’re wrong.
pairs.chinese: 而且80%的时间，你是错的

pairs.english: You’re taking 20% best, and it’s virtually impossible...
pairs.chinese: 最多20%的胜率

pairs.english: ..to be making money if you win only 20% of the time.
pairs.chinese: 很难让你稳定盈利

pairs.english: After traders lose enough money, they start to look for help.
pairs.chinese: 在交易者亏了很多钱之后，他们开始寻找帮助

pairs.english: They’re desperate to believe in anything.
pairs.chinese: 他们迫切地想相信任何东西

pairs.english: And there are lots of well-intentioned people out there...
pairs.chinese: 有很多“热心”的人想帮助你

pairs.english: ..who want to help you, but a lot of them are dishonest,
pairs.chinese: 但他们中的大部分都不诚实

issues.comment: 'a lot' rendered as 'most'.

pairs.english: and a lot of them teach you that knowing candlestick patterns...
pairs.chinese: 很多人教你蜡烛图形态

pairs.english: ..is the only road to making a fortune as a trader.
pairs.chinese: 告诉你，这可以让你成功

pairs.english: And that’s simply not the case.
pairs.chinese: 事实并非如此

pairs.english: Here, big bull reversal bar.
pairs.chinese: 这里，阳线，反转K线

pairs.english: Buy? No, you don’t buy.
pairs.chinese: 买入吗？不，不要买

pairs.english: It’s following 3 bear bars.
pairs.chinese: 它的前面是三根更大的阴线

issues.comment: ZH adds 'bigger'. Check chart frames around 685-695 s.

pairs.english: Look to the left.
pairs.chinese: 记得多看看左边是什么样子

pairs.english: The market’s going down, so if anything, you’re looking to sell.
pairs.chinese: 市场在下跌，你应该找做空机会

pairs.english: So if candlesticks are not the answer, then what is price action?
pairs.chinese: 价格行为是什么？显然，蜡烛图形态不是答案

pairs.english: Listen to the traders on television,
pairs.chinese: 听一听电视上的职业交易员

pairs.english: expert traders, traders who trade for a living.
pairs.chinese: 真正靠交易为生的人

pairs.english: Listen to what they say.
pairs.chinese: 听听他们怎么说

pairs.english: They tell you every day what’s important,
pairs.chinese: 他们每天都在告诉你什么是重要的

pairs.english: and they virtually never mention a candlestick pattern.
pairs.chinese: 但是从来不会提到什么蜡烛图形态

issues.comment: EN 'virtually never mention' -> ZH '从来不会'; nearly never ≠ literally zero.

pairs.english: So what do traders talk about? If they’re not talking...
pairs.chinese: 那么交易员们谈论的是什么？

pairs.english: ..about all these candlestick patterns that you see on the Internet,
pairs.chinese: 如果他们不谈论你在网上看到的蜡烛图形态

pairs.english: what are they talking about? How are they making money?
pairs.chinese: 他们在谈论什么？他们是怎么赚钱的？

pairs.english: One of the most important things that they talk about is support and resistance.
pairs.chinese: 他们谈论的最重要的事情之一是支撑和阻力

pairs.english: And that comes in many forms.
pairs.chinese: 支撑阻力有很多种形式

pairs.english: Moving Averages.
pairs.chinese: 比如移动平均线

pairs.english: Channels.
pairs.chinese: 通道

pairs.english: Here’s the average price, right? They’re interested to see...
pairs.chinese: 这是平均价格

pairs.english: ..how the market reacts to the average price.
pairs.chinese: 交易员们对市场回到平均价格后的反应很感兴趣

pairs.english: So we’re falling down strongly, and when it gets back...
pairs.chinese: 非常强的下降趋势

pairs.english: ..to the average price, that’s probably expensive.
pairs.chinese: 当它反弹到平均价格时 这很可能是过高的定价

pairs.english: Traders will look to sell.
pairs.chinese: 所以这是交易者做空的机会

pairs.english: It becomes resistance.
pairs.chinese: 于是成为了阻力

pairs.english: Here, we’re rallying strongly.
pairs.chinese: 这里，强势上涨

pairs.english: When it gets down near the average price...
pairs.chinese: 回调到过去20根K线， 或者100根K线的平均价格时

pairs.english: ..over the past 20 bars, 100 bars, it reverses up.
pairs.chinese: 反转向上

pairs.english: Support.
pairs.chinese: 这就是支撑

pairs.english: And they also look at channels.
pairs.chinese: 他们也看通道

pairs.english: Here’s a bear channel after a bull breakout, so it’s probably a bull flag.
pairs.chinese: 这里是一个多头突破后的下降通道， 所以它可能是一个牛旗

pairs.english: Traders also spend a lot of time looking at prior highs and lows.
pairs.chinese: 交易者们也重点关注前期的高点和低点

pairs.english: The market rallied to this point and sold off.
pairs.chinese: 之前涨到这个高点，然后下跌（阻力）

pairs.english: It broke strongly above it, came down near that point, and it’s now support.
pairs.chinese: 强势突破之后，回调重新测试了这个高点， 阻力变成支撑了

pairs.english: It rallied again.
pairs.chinese: 然后再次上涨

pairs.english: It broke below it, tried to get above it again, failed.
pairs.chinese: 跌破了这个位置，试图再次突破，失败了

pairs.english: Tried to get above it again, failed.
pairs.chinese: 试图再次向上突破，失败

pairs.english: That high was resistance, and then support, and then resistance again.
pairs.chinese: 那个高点一开始是是阻力，然后是支撑， 然后又是阻力

issues.comment: Duplicated 是.

pairs.english: This low, the market broke strongly low below it.
pairs.chinese: 这个低点，市场强势跌破了它

pairs.english: It tested it, could not get above it.
pairs.chinese: 反弹，回测，无法继续向上

pairs.english: There was resistance.
pairs.chinese: 那里有阻力

pairs.english: Tried to get above it again, resistance.
pairs.chinese: 试图再次突破，遇到了阻力

pairs.english: Tried to get above it again, resistance.
pairs.chinese: 试图再次突破，还是有阻力

pairs.english: Another thing that traders always talk about is how strong a trend is.
pairs.chinese: 职业交易员谈论的另一件事是趋势的强度

pairs.english: For example, if the market’s in a bull trend, you want to see Higher Lows.
pairs.chinese: 例如，如果市场处于上涨趋势， 你想看到低点抬高

pairs.english: You want to see Higher Highs.
pairs.chinese: 高点也抬高

pairs.english: And if you see that, traders are more inclined to buy – buy for any reason.
pairs.chinese: 如果你看到这些，交易者们更倾向于做多 以任何理由买入做多

pairs.english: In a bear trend, they look at Lower Highs and they want to see Lower Lows.
pairs.chinese: 在下降趋势中，他们看到高点降低 地点也降低

issues.comment: 地点 should be 低点.

pairs.english: And if the market is going down, they’re more inclined...
pairs.chinese: 既然市场在下跌，他们更倾向于做空

pairs.english: ..to sell until there’s a clear reversal up.
pairs.chinese: 不断地卖出，直到有明确的反转向上

pairs.english: Here, a bear trend, strong bull breakout.
pairs.chinese: 这里，一个下降趋势，强劲的多头突破

pairs.english: Higher Low, big enough pattern for a Major Trend Reversal,
pairs.chinese: 低点抬高，是一个大反转的模式

pairs.english: and it reversed into a bull trend.
pairs.chinese: 反转形成上涨趋势

pairs.english: Bear channel, bear trend.
pairs.chinese: 下降通道，下降趋势

pairs.english: Bull channel, bull trend.
pairs.chinese: 上涨通道，上涨趋势

pairs.english: There are two forces that are very important, and they control all markets.
pairs.chinese: 有两个非常重要的力量，它们控制着所有市场

pairs.english: First of all there’s context, and momentum.
pairs.chinese: 首先是背景和动能

pairs.english: Remember I said that context means all the bars to the left.
pairs.chinese: 我之前说过，背景意味着左边的所有K线

pairs.english: Where is the support and resistance? I talk about this...
pairs.chinese: 支撑和阻力在哪里？

pairs.english: ..in a separate video on support and resistance.
pairs.chinese: 我在支撑和阻力的视频中具体讲解了这部分

pairs.english: For example, we’re falling here, and if you draw a line across these tops,
pairs.chinese: 例如，市场在下跌，如果你把这些高点连成一条线

pairs.english: you’ll see that every time it gets near the line, it falls.
pairs.chinese: 你会看到每次它接近那条线时，就会下跌

pairs.english: Even if it gets above the line, it falls – above the line, it falls.
pairs.chinese: 即使它稍稍超过了那条线，也会下跌 超过了一点点，又跌回去了

pairs.english: And prior highs and lows are important.
pairs.chinese: 前期的高点和低点很重要

pairs.english: We’re in a bear trend; you’re looking to sell.
pairs.chinese: 市场处于下降趋势中； 你要寻找做空的机会

pairs.english: Selling pullbacks is a good thing to do, so if it gets near a trend line...
pairs.chinese: 反弹的时候逢高做空是一个好的选择

pairs.english: ..and reverses down, that’s a good thing to sell.
pairs.chinese: 接近趋势线，并反转向下， 那是一个好的做空入场点

pairs.english: Near the trend line, reverses down.
pairs.chinese: 接近趋势线，反转向下

pairs.english: Near the trend line, place a stop order to go short just below the prior bar.
pairs.chinese: 接近趋势线时，在前一根K线下方挂突破卖单

pairs.english: Then look at this.
pairs.chinese: 再来看这里

pairs.english: Every time it gets near the prior low, it goes up.
pairs.chinese: 每次它接近之前的低点时，就会反弹

pairs.english: So there’s support at prior lows.
pairs.chinese: 所以之前的低点有支撑

pairs.english: Traders will look to buy reversals up.
pairs.chinese: 交易者会寻找向上反转的做多机会

pairs.english: When the market makes a new low, they’ll place a stop order...
pairs.chinese: 当价格创新低时，他们会在前一根K线的高点上方

pairs.english: ..to buy above the high of the prior bar.
pairs.chinese: 挂突破买单

pairs.english: These little green boxes are where they get in.
pairs.chinese: 我用绿色框框来标记入场点

pairs.english: Traders who look to sell at resistance and buy at support are value investors.
pairs.chinese: 那些在阻力位卖出，在支撑位买入的交易者是价值投资者

pairs.english: They want to buy when it’s cheap and sell when it’s expensive.
pairs.chinese: 他们想在便宜时买入，在昂贵时卖出

pairs.english: Now, I said there were two things.
pairs.chinese: 我刚才说有两个力量控制着市场

pairs.english: I said context and momentum.
pairs.chinese: 分别是背景和动能

pairs.english: Momentum refers to the strength of the trend.
pairs.chinese: 动能指的是趋势的强度

pairs.english: The video on breakouts talks a lot more about momentum.
pairs.chinese: 讲突破的视频课中，我会详细地讲动量

issues.comment: Elsewhere momentum is 动能 (cues 244, 267, 268, 272, 292, 296, 304). Use one term.

pairs.english: Now look at this.
pairs.chinese: 看这里

pairs.english: We’re falling pretty strongly here, rallying pretty strongly here.
pairs.chinese: 很强的下跌，很强的上涨

pairs.english: When momentum is strong, traders want to trade in the direction of the momentum.
pairs.chinese: 当动能强劲时，交易者们想要沿着动能的方向交易

pairs.english: So if it’s falling strongly, traders should be looking to sell.
pairs.chinese: 如果下跌的动能很强，交易者们应该做空

pairs.english: You can sell even the close of this bar, betting that any reversal up...
pairs.chinese: 甚至可以在大阴线的收盘去追空

issues.comment: ZH adds 'big bear bar'; check the chart.

pairs.english: ..will probably stay below that high and be followed by lower prices.
pairs.chinese: 押注任何反弹都不会超过这个高点 然后市场会继续下跌

pairs.english: And the same is true here.
pairs.chinese: 这里也是一样

pairs.english: You could buy the close of this bar,
pairs.chinese: 可以在大阳线的收盘追涨

pairs.english: knowing that there’ll be at least a little bit more up.
pairs.chinese: 因为你知道，它大概率还会至少再涨一点

issues.comment: EN 'knowing that there'll be at least a little bit more up' author's strong expectation; ZH adds '大概率', acceptable softened reading but not measured.

pairs.english: And here, it pulled back but held above the bottom...
pairs.chinese: 这里尽管有回调，但始终高于上涨趋势的起点

pairs.english: ..of the bull trend, and it starts to turn up again.
pairs.chinese: 然后再次上涨

pairs.english: So traders will buy on the reversal back up.
pairs.chinese: 所以交易者会在反转向上时买入

pairs.english: So they’ll buy the breakout or the pullback.
pairs.chinese: 所以他们会在突破或回调时买入

pairs.english: Here, they’ll sell the breakout or the pullback.
pairs.chinese: 这里，他们会在突破或反弹时卖空

pairs.english: They don’t sell simply here.
pairs.chinese: 他们不仅仅在这里卖空

pairs.english: They sold all the way down.
pairs.chinese: 他们一路卖

pairs.english: You could even sell at the worst price and make money.
pairs.chinese: 你甚至可以卖在阶段的最低点， 然后依旧赚钱

pairs.english: The same with here.
pairs.chinese: 这里也是一样

pairs.english: Traders don’t all buy that close.
pairs.chinese: 交易者们不是只在它的收盘买入

pairs.english: A lot of them bought all the way up here.
pairs.chinese: 很多人从底部开始，一直在买入

pairs.english: That’s why we got this strong breakout; everybody’s buying.
pairs.chinese: 这就是为什么出现了这个强势突破；大家都在买入

pairs.english: Look at here.
pairs.chinese: 看这里

pairs.english: The market’s losing momentum.
pairs.chinese: 市场失去动能

pairs.english: We have a couple bear bars, but they’re small, followed by a bull bar.
pairs.chinese: 有几根阴线，但它们很小，后面跟着一根阳线

pairs.english: A bear bar with a tail.
pairs.chinese: 下一根阴线，下影线很长

pairs.english: A small bear bar followed by a bull reversal bar.
pairs.chinese: 小阴线，后面是一根反转的阳线

pairs.english: The momentum down is getting weak.
pairs.chinese: 向下的动能变弱

pairs.english: Compare that to this.
pairs.chinese: 与此相比

pairs.english: Traders are buying every low.
pairs.chinese: 交易者在每个前期低点挂单买入

issues.comment: ZH adds limit orders (挂单) and 'prior'.

pairs.english: Bulls are making money buying every low,
pairs.chinese: 而且通过这种做法赚到了钱

pairs.english: betting that the trend will not fall that much further.
pairs.chinese: 所以他们押注趋势不会再跌太多

pairs.english: The market is transitioning from a strong bear trend into a weak bear trend,
pairs.chinese: 市场正在从强下降趋势 过渡到弱下降趋势

pairs.english: and then possibly a Trading Range Double Bottom)...
pairs.chinese: 然后可能是一个震荡区间（有双底）

pairs.english: ..and then possibly even a bull trend.
pairs.chinese: 甚至反转成为上涨趋势

pairs.english: So the momentum is weakening and traders start looking for reversal trades.
pairs.chinese: 所以动能在减弱，交易者们开始寻找做反转的机会

pairs.english: For example, buy the reversal up.
pairs.chinese: 比如在开始反转向上时买入

pairs.english: We have a Double Bottom, maybe a slightly Lower Low Major Trend Reversal.
pairs.chinese: 双底，低点降低的大反转模式（LLMTR）

pairs.english: We have a bear trend, strong bull breakout above the top...
pairs.chinese: 下降趋势，突破了下降通道线

pairs.english: ..of the bear channel, and then a test of the bear trend low
pairs.chinese: 然后测试前期的低点

pairs.english: and a reversal up, and a second and a third reversal up.
pairs.chinese: 再次反转向上，第二次和第三次反转向上

pairs.english: So that is a reasonable reversal trade to take.
pairs.chinese: 所以这是一笔合理的反转交易

pairs.english: I pay a lot of attention to early signs of strength.
pairs.chinese: 我非常关注强度转变的信号

issues.comment: 'early' is lost; better 早期的强势迹象.

pairs.english: So we’re in a bear trend, but look at this.
pairs.chinese: 市场处于下降趋势中，但是看这里

pairs.english: We have 4 consecutive bull bars, 2 of them...
pairs.chinese: 四根连续的阳线，全部收在高位

issues.comment: EN313 says four consecutive bull bars, two with large bodies begins in cue314; ZH313 already says all four close high, and ZH314 states two huge bodies. Overall passage meaning preserved but per-cue content reordered.

pairs.english: ..with very big bull bodies, all 4 closing near their highs.
pairs.chinese: 其中两根实体部分非常大

pairs.english: Bear trend, yes, but we have a sudden burst of buying.
pairs.chinese: 下降趋势，突然的爆发上涨

pairs.english: And, that’s a lot of strength on the part of the bulls,
pairs.chinese: 这代表多头买入的强度非常大

pairs.english: and they refer to that as Buying Pressure.
pairs.chinese: 交易者称之为买入压力，买压

pairs.english: So I pay attention to Buying Pressure.
pairs.chinese: 所以我会关注买压

pairs.english: Here, here, we sold off strongly but it reversed up strongly.
pairs.chinese: 这里，这里，下跌，但又强势地反转向上

pairs.english: The market is becoming more bullish.
pairs.chinese: 市场变得更加看涨

pairs.english: We’re getting a lot of Buying Pressure.
pairs.chinese: 这里有非常强的买压

pairs.english: And on the way down, I look at Selling Pressure.
pairs.chinese: 在下跌过程中，我关注卖出压力，卖压

pairs.english: We have a lot of bars down.
pairs.chinese: 连续很多根阴线下跌

pairs.english: Every bar, the high is below the high of the prior bar; the low is below...
pairs.chinese: 每一根K线的高点都在降低

pairs.english: ..the low of the prior bar, so we’re trending down pretty strongly.
pairs.chinese: 低点也在降低，很强势的下跌

pairs.english: Odds are selling for any reason, we’ll get at least a little bit more down.
pairs.chinese: 以任何理由做空，因为大概率还会继续下跌

pairs.english: Traders also pay attention to the strength of the trend.
pairs.chinese: 交易者们关注趋势的强度

pairs.english: I told you that in addition to risk and reward,
pairs.chinese: 除了风险和回报，盈亏比

pairs.english: they need to pay attention to probability.
pairs.chinese: 他们需要关注概率

pairs.english: And a very important thing is trade management.
pairs.chinese: 管理一笔交易，是非常重要的事情

pairs.english: Once they take a trade, they have to manage it correctly.
pairs.chinese: 下单之后，他们必须正确地管理

pairs.english: To make money as a trader, candlestick patterns that’s not the answer.
pairs.chinese: 想要成为交易员，不能靠蜡烛图形态

pairs.english: They’re basically totally unnecessary.
pairs.chinese: 完全没有必要去学它

pairs.english: They can be a useful small piece of the big picture,
pairs.chinese: 也许是大局中的一个有用的小零件

pairs.english: but they’re really not important.
pairs.chinese: 总之不怎么重要

pairs.english: A lot of institutions trade off line charts.
pairs.chinese: 很多机构使用线型图交易

pairs.english: They don’t care about the candlestick patterns.
pairs.chinese: 他们根本不看蜡烛图形态

pairs.english: They know that the direction of the trend, the strength of the trend,
pairs.chinese: 他们知道趋势的方向，趋势的强度

pairs.english: support and resistance are far more important than candlestick patterns.
pairs.chinese: 支撑和阻力比蜡烛图形态重要得多

pairs.english: So if you look at this line chart, are you thinking...
pairs.chinese: 如果你看着这张线型图，

pairs.english: ..that a candlestick pattern would make it more bullish?
pairs.chinese: 难道看蜡烛图形态能让趋势更强？

pairs.english: Or are you saying “Wow, this is going up really fast.
pairs.chinese: 或者你会说“哇，涨得真快。

pairs.english: Higher Lows, Higher Highs – I’ve got to buy”?
pairs.chinese: 更高的低点，更高的高点—— 我也要买入做多”

pairs.english: A candlestick pattern is not going to make it any more bullish.
pairs.chinese: 蜡烛图形态不会改变任何东西

pairs.english: When you see this, you’ve got to buy,
pairs.chinese: 当看到这个，必须得买入

issues.comment: EN 'you've got to buy' in retrospective line-chart teaching, ZH '必须得买入'; preserve as lecturer rhetorical imperative, NOT a universal automatic buy rule.

pairs.english: and the candlestick pattern will not help you.
pairs.chinese: 蜡烛图形态不会提供任何帮助

pairs.english: Now, I want to say a few things about indicators.
pairs.chinese: 接下来，我想说一些关于指标的事情

pairs.english: When I first started trading, all the magazines...
pairs.chinese: 当我刚开始交易时，

pairs.english: ..had pictures that looked like this.
pairs.chinese: 所有的杂志都有这种图片

pairs.english: They tried to stuff as many indicators onto the chart as possible...
pairs.chinese: 他们试图在图上添加尽可能多的指标

pairs.english: ..to lead you to believe that if you buy their software...
pairs.chinese: 让你相信，如果你买他们的软件

pairs.english: ..that can create all of these indicators, you’re going to get rich.
pairs.chinese: 可以创建所有这些指标

pairs.english: You’ll have some big advantages that will allow you to make money.
pairs.chinese: 你比其他人就有更多优势 你就可以赚钱

pairs.english: Does all of this stuff really help?
pairs.chinese: 这些东西真的有帮助吗？

pairs.english: If one indicator is good, is two, three, four better?
pairs.chinese: 如果一个指标有用，那么多来几个会更有用吗？

pairs.english: Having 10, is that better?
pairs.chinese: 不如加10个指标，会不会赚更多钱？

pairs.english: The answer is no.
pairs.chinese: 答案是否定的

pairs.english: In fact, you can barely see the chart
pairs.chinese: 事实上，有这么多指标覆盖在图上

pairs.english: with all of these indicators all over the chart.
pairs.chinese: 你几乎看不清图上的价格行为

pairs.english: Your eye is going to get focused onto the indicators...
pairs.chinese: 指标会分散你的注意力

pairs.english: ..and you will not be paying attention to the chart.
pairs.chinese: 让你无法关注图表本身

pairs.english: Here’s the same chart with the indicators removed.
pairs.chinese: 这是同一张图，移除指标之后的

pairs.english: I can see what’s going on.
pairs.chinese: 我可以看到发生了什么

pairs.english: The bulls are trying to break out.
pairs.chinese: 多头试图突破

pairs.english: We have a big reversal bar.
pairs.chinese: 但是突破失败，大的反转K线向下

issues.comment: ZH adds 'breakout failed' and 'downward'. Check chart frames around 1270-1282 s.

pairs.english: We’re probably going to continue back down.
pairs.chinese: 可能会继续下跌，回到区间的底部

issues.comment: ZH adds a target (bottom of range).

pairs.english: A Trading Range breakout probably will fail.
pairs.chinese: 震荡区间的突破经常会失败

issues.comment: Probability of this breakout rendered as general frequency.

pairs.english: I’m looking to sell.
pairs.chinese: 我会在它的下方做空

pairs.english: Three pushes down, a Trading Range breakout below – I’m looking to buy.
pairs.chinese: 三次下跌，震荡区间向下突破失败 ——我在找买入机会

issues.comment: ZH adds 'failed'. Check chart.

pairs.english: A Triangle, breakout, small Triangle inside...
pairs.chinese: 收敛三角形，突破模式 它是大三角形里面的一个小三角形

issues.comment: ZH introduces 'Breakout Mode' (a distinct Brooks term); the EN subtitle only says 'breakout'. Audio not checked.

pairs.english: ..of a bigger Triangle – I’m probably going to sell.
pairs.chinese: 我会在突破的时候做空

issues.comment: ZH adds 'at the breakout'.

pairs.english: Strong bear trend, a bull reversal,
pairs.chinese: 强下降趋势，多头尝试反转

pairs.english: probably going to fail – I’m looking to sell.
pairs.chinese: 大概率会失败，所以我会继续做空

pairs.english: A minor reversal, possible Final Flag,
pairs.chinese: 前期的反弹，有可能是末端旗形

issues.comment: 'minor reversal' rendered as 'the earlier rally'.

pairs.english: decent buy reversal bar – I’ll look to buy.
pairs.chinese: 不错的反转信号K线（也是双K反转） 我会买入尝试做反转

issues.comment: '(also a two-bar reversal)' is the translator's addition; verify on chart.

pairs.english: 50% pullback from the selloff, I’m going to start looking to sell.
pairs.chinese: 下降趋势的50%反弹，我会找机会做空

pairs.english: Ok, we’ve got a second entry short,
pairs.chinese: 好，第二个做空入场点

pairs.english: we have a small Double Top here, I’m looking to sell.
pairs.chinese: 小的双顶，不错的做空机会

pairs.english: Small Triangle, failed bull breakout.
pairs.chinese: 小三角形，多头突破失败

pairs.english: I’m going to bet that will continue down at least for a little bit more.
pairs.chinese: 我会在做空信号K下方开仓做空

issues.comment: ZH cue 380 has content not in EN 380 (entry below the signal bar); ZH 381 carries EN 380's meaning.

pairs.english: I’m looking to sell.
pairs.chinese: 押注价格至少再下跌一点

pairs.english: Higher Low Major Trend Reversal.
pairs.chinese: 低点抬高的大反转模式

pairs.english: Bear trend, bull breakout, Higher Low, but selloff not all that strong.
pairs.chinese: 下降趋势，多头突破，低点抬高 而且这一段下跌并不强

pairs.english: Two legs down – one, pullback, two – I’m going to look to buy.
pairs.chinese: 两次下跌，1，回调，2 我会买入做多

pairs.english: And the indicators don’t show me any of that.
pairs.chinese: 指标并没有显示这些（交易机会）

pairs.english: So for me, I personally prefer just to look at the charts and try to understand...
pairs.chinese: 对我来说，我个人更喜欢只看K线图

pairs.english: ..what the market is doing, and then I place trades based upon the price action.
pairs.chinese: 并试图理解市场在做什么， 然后我根据价格行为下单

pairs.english: To me, I don’t like indicators because I get stressed out constantly looking...
pairs.chinese: 对我来说，我不喜欢指标 因为指标在不断寻找趋势中的反转

issues.comment: EN: the trader using indicators keeps hunting reversals/breakouts and gets stressed. ZH: the indicators are hunting reversals.

pairs.english: ..for reversals in trends and constantly looking for breakouts in Trading Ranges.
pairs.chinese: 不断寻找震荡区间中的突破 这让我感到很有压力

pairs.english: And it’s the exact opposite of what I should be doing.
pairs.chinese: 这与我应该做事的完全相反

pairs.english: This is a common thing that you see.
pairs.chinese: 你经常会看到这样的事情

pairs.english: Ok, look at this low and this low in the indicator.
pairs.chinese: 看看指标中的这个低点和这个低点

pairs.english: So we’ve got a low, we have a Higher Low, we have a Higher Low.
pairs.chinese: 低点抬高了，这个低点更高

pairs.english: This is a divergence, this is a double divergence.
pairs.chinese: 这被称作背离，这是一个双重背离

pairs.english: And the websites will tell you, “Ah, you’ve got...
pairs.chinese: 网上的“指标达人”会告诉你：

pairs.english: ..a double divergence, you’ve got to look to buy.
pairs.chinese: 双重背离，你应该要买入

pairs.english: Right? Here we’ve got lower prices and then we have a higher oscillator.
pairs.chinese: 价格创新低了，但是震荡指标在向上

pairs.english: You have to buy.”
pairs.chinese: 赶紧买入抄底”

pairs.english: No. Look at the bars.
pairs.chinese: 不。看K线就知道了

pairs.english: You’re in a really Tight Bear Channel with virtually no significant pullback.
pairs.chinese: 非常窄的下降通道，几乎没有明显的反弹

pairs.english: It’s far easier to make money selling.
pairs.chinese: 做空赚钱要容易得多

pairs.english: So even though we’ve got a divergence – here’s another divergence –
pairs.chinese: 即使指标显示有背离 这里是又有背离

pairs.english: price is going down, indicator is going up.
pairs.chinese: 价格在下跌，指标在上升

pairs.english: Higher Lows.
pairs.chinese: 更高的低点

pairs.english: It’s crazy, right? That’s the single biggest problem...
pairs.chinese: 这太疯狂了，对吧？

pairs.english: ..with indicators for beginners.
pairs.chinese: 这是新手使用指标时面临的最大问题

pairs.english: They look at the indicator or patterns.
pairs.chinese: 他们看指标或形态

pairs.english: “Oh, a diversion.
pairs.chinese: “哇！指标背离了

issues.comment: EN subtitle says 'diversion'; context and ZH indicate 'divergence'.

pairs.english: I’ve got to buy.” They don’t look at the chart.
pairs.chinese: 我要买入抄底“ 但他们不看K线图

pairs.english: When the market’s in a Small Pullback Bear Trend,
pairs.chinese: 当市场处于几乎没有反弹的下降趋势时

issues.comment: Named Brooks pattern rendered descriptively; canonical form such as 小回调下降趋势 should follow the glossary.

pairs.english: you can only make money selling, not buying.
pairs.chinese: 你只能通过做空赚钱，而不是做多

pairs.english: So indicators, it’s an excuse to avoid thinking about the obvious.
pairs.chinese: 所以依靠指标，是一个不愿意思考的借口

pairs.english: So buying in a strong bear trend – yes, it can work and you can make a fortune.
pairs.chinese: 在一个强劲的下降趋势中买入—— 它偶尔可以让你赚钱

issues.comment: Point is that the payoff can be huge but rare; ZH loses 'fortune'.

pairs.english: But, so the risk/reward is great.
pairs.chinese: 因为盈亏比很好

pairs.english: You buy here, your risk is here.
pairs.chinese: 你在这里买入，你的止损在这里

pairs.english: Very little money at risk.
pairs.chinese: 风险非常小

pairs.english: We could go up forever, so your reward is huge.
pairs.chinese: 如果反转，一直往上涨 你的利润非常大

pairs.english: However, what is the probability? The probability is extremely low.
pairs.chinese: 然而，概率是多少？概率非常低

pairs.english: So you need much more than risk/reward.
pairs.chinese: 交易者需要的不仅仅是盈亏比

pairs.english: One of the unfortunate things on television...
pairs.chinese: 电视上的“专家”

pairs.english: ..is traders constantly talk about risk and reward.
pairs.chinese: 总是谈论小风险，大回报

pairs.english: They never talk about probability, but that’s the flipside of risk/reward.
pairs.chinese: 从不谈论概率，但那很重要， 是盈亏比的另一面

pairs.english: Whenever a trade has excellent risk/reward...
pairs.chinese: 如果一笔交易有极好的盈亏比 即小风险，大回报

pairs.english: ..(in other words, small risk, great reward) it also has very little probability.
pairs.chinese: 那么它的胜率也非常小

pairs.english: Because there has to be a reason for an institution to take the other side.
pairs.chinese: 因为必须存在一个理由， 让某些机构去做对手盘

pairs.english: So if you get great risk/reward, guess what? The institution taking...
pairs.chinese: 如果你得到了极好的盈亏比 那么你的对手盘呢？

pairs.english: ..the other side of your trade has high probability.
pairs.chinese: 他们得到了很高的胜率

pairs.english: He’s probably going to make money.
pairs.chinese: 这些机构更有可能赚钱

pairs.english: Every now and then you’ll make a lot of money,
pairs.chinese: 逆势抄底，偶尔你会赚很多钱 （前提是能够坚定持有，而不是赚了一点就离场）

issues.comment: Parenthetical advice is the translator's, not the lecturer's.

pairs.english: but most of the time you’re going to lose.
pairs.chinese: 但大多数时候你会亏钱

pairs.english: So you keep getting these small losses.
pairs.chinese: 然后小的损失不断积累

pairs.english: Your indicators are telling you to buy.
pairs.chinese: 指标告诉你：买入

pairs.english: Buy, buy, buy. Buy, buy, buy.
pairs.chinese: 买，买，买。买，买，买

pairs.english: You buy, you lose.
pairs.chinese: 你买了，也亏钱了

pairs.english: You buy, you lose.
pairs.chinese: 你又买了，又亏钱

pairs.english: You buy, you lose.
pairs.chinese: 继续买，继续亏

pairs.english: And you’re not losing much – remember, your risk is small –
pairs.chinese: 尽管每次亏得不多，因为止损很小 （至于不止损的人......）

issues.comment: Translator's aside.

pairs.english: however, you can bleed to death from a thousand papercuts.
pairs.chinese: 但是水滴石穿

issues.comment: 水滴石穿 means persistence wears through stone (a positive idiom); EN means many small losses are fatal. Suggest 积少成多的小亏损会让你失血而亡 / 千刀万剐式的小亏损.

pairs.english: Those small losses add up.
pairs.chinese: 那些小损失加起来，就是大的亏损

pairs.english: You have to be patient.
pairs.chinese: 想成为优秀的交易员，必须要有耐心

pairs.english: There’s a lot to learn.
pairs.chinese: 有很多东西要学

pairs.english: That’s why there are so many videos in this course.
pairs.chinese: 这就是为什么这门课程有这么多视频的原因

pairs.english: I’m trying to teach you everything...
pairs.chinese: 我尝试把成为一名优秀交易员所需要的所有东西

pairs.english: ..that you need to know to be a successful trader.
pairs.chinese: 都教给你

pairs.english: And there are no shortcuts.
pairs.chinese: 成功没有捷径

pairs.english: Indicators are not a shortcut.
pairs.chinese: 指标不是捷径

pairs.english: Candlestick patterns are not a shortcut.
pairs.chinese: 蜡烛图形态不是捷径

pairs.english: And trading is never going to be easy because you’re competing against...
pairs.chinese: 交易永远不是一件容易的事情

pairs.english: ..extremely smart, hardworking people who have been doing this for years,
pairs.chinese: 因为你在与极其聪明、勤奋的人竞争

pairs.english: and they don’t want to give you a penny.
pairs.chinese: 他们已经做了多年，他们不想让你赚一分钱

pairs.english: They want to take every penny that they can get – and that’s their job.
pairs.chinese: 他们想拿走他们能拿到的每一分钱 那是他们的工作

pairs.english: That’s what they should do.
pairs.chinese: 那是他们应该做的

pairs.english: That’s my job, and that’s what I try to do every day.
pairs.chinese: 那也是我的工作，那是我每天都在做的

pairs.english: But even though it’s hard, I really enjoy the challenge.
pairs.chinese: 即使很难，但是我很享受这个挑战

pairs.english: Well, what type of chart? Look at this chart.
pairs.chinese: 交易者应该看什么类型的图呢？ 看一下这张图

pairs.english: Ok, this is the euro versus the yen.
pairs.chinese: 是欧元兑日元

pairs.english: It’s a monthly chart.
pairs.chinese: 这是月K线

pairs.english: When you look at it, if you didn’t look at the time axis,
pairs.chinese: 不看时间坐标的话，是无法分辨的

pairs.english: you would say maybe it’s a 5-minute chart,
pairs.chinese: 它可能是5分钟图

pairs.english: maybe it’s a 1-minute chart, maybe it’s a 60-minute chart.
pairs.chinese: 可能是1分钟图， 也可能是60分钟图

pairs.english: It’s a monthly chart.
pairs.chinese: 实际上它是月K线图

pairs.english: And the point I’m trying to make is some traders do not want to trade intraday.
pairs.chinese: 我想说的是，有些交易者不喜欢日内交易

pairs.english: And they’ll trade daily charts or weekly charts or monthly charts.
pairs.chinese: 他们想在日线图，周线图或月线图上交易

pairs.english: It doesn’t matter; the process is still the same.
pairs.chinese: 没有任何的区别，过程仍然是相同的

issues.comment: EN 'It doesn't matter; process is still same' refers to visual process across timeframes, ZH '没有任何的区别' could wrongly imply costs/size/stops identical; explicitly limited by cues474–477.

pairs.english: The market’s going up.
pairs.chinese: 市场在上涨

pairs.english: Traders are looking to buy pullbacks, or they’ll even buy breakouts.
pairs.chinese: 交易者在回调时买入，甚至在突破时买入做多

pairs.english: If we’re trying to top, traders will start to sell.
pairs.chinese: 如果价格尝试筑顶，反转， 交易者会开始做空

pairs.english: This process is the same.
pairs.chinese: 这个过程是一样的

pairs.english: It doesn’t matter what the timeframe is.
pairs.chinese: 时间级别无关紧要

issues.comment: EN 'It doesn't matter what the timeframe is' in context of pattern processes; ZH '时间级别无关紧要' potentially absolute; later author emphasizes monthly stop/position sizing differ.

pairs.english: All markets are fractal.
pairs.chinese: 所有市场都具有分型结构

issues.comment: Standard term is 分形; 分型 has a different specific meaning in Chinese technical analysis.

pairs.english: Bigger patterns are made up of smaller patterns;
pairs.chinese: 更大的形态是由更小的形态组成的

pairs.english: smaller patterns are parts of bigger patterns.
pairs.chinese: 更小的形态是更大形态的一部分

pairs.english: It’s all the same thing.
pairs.chinese: 都是一样的

pairs.english: If you do trade a monthly chart, the bars are very big,
pairs.chinese: 如果你用月K线交易，因为K线非常大

pairs.english: so the stop is very far away.
pairs.chinese: 所以止损非常远

pairs.english: You have to trade very small to make sure that the risk on your trade...
pairs.chinese: 你必须用非常小的仓位

issues.comment: Key point (keep per-trade risk the same as on other trades) is lost.

pairs.english: ..is no bigger than the risk on any other trade.
pairs.chinese: 来控制你的风险

pairs.english: In this video I talked about candlestick patterns...
pairs.chinese: 在这个视频中，我谈到了蜡烛图形态

pairs.english: ..and how they are not particularly helpful.
pairs.chinese: 以及为什么它们没用

issues.comment: Hedged EN rendered absolute.

pairs.english: I also discussed what professional traders talk about.
pairs.chinese: 我还讨论了真正的职业交易者， 他们会谈论哪些话题

pairs.english: And as I said, they talk much more about support and resistance,
pairs.chinese: 正如我所说，他们更多地谈论支撑和阻力

pairs.english: and momentum and strength of trends than they do about candlestick patterns.
pairs.chinese: 谈论动能和趋势强度，而不是蜡烛图形态

pairs.english: They virtually never talk about candlestick patterns.
pairs.chinese: 他们几乎从不谈论蜡烛图形态

pairs.english: And I also talked about indicators and how it’s very easy...
pairs.chinese: 我还谈到了指标，

pairs.english: ..to get overly dependent on them.
pairs.chinese: 以及新手为什么非常容易过度依赖指标

pairs.english: And if you use them, you’ll find...
pairs.chinese: 如果你使用指标，你往往会发现

pairs.english: ..that they probably don’t help you make any money.
pairs.chinese: 它们无法帮助你赚钱

issues.comment: 'probably' dropped.

pairs.english: I don’t have a problem with somebody using indicators...
pairs.chinese: 我不反对使用指标

pairs.english: ..if they’re making money and if they’re happy.
pairs.chinese: 前提是你在很开心地赚钱

pairs.english: But if you’re not making money and if you’re stressed out using them,
pairs.chinese: 但如果你没有赚钱，而且使用指标时感到压力

pairs.english: then I would get rid of them and just look at the charts.
pairs.chinese: 我的建议是，摆脱它们，只看价格行为

pairs.english: And if you look on television, you rarely ever see...
pairs.chinese: 如果你看职业交易员做交易

pairs.english: ..anybody putting an indicator up.
pairs.chinese: 你很少看到有人在图上放一个指标

pairs.english: And that’s because most professional traders don’t pay attention to them.
pairs.chinese: 因为绝大多数职业交易员不关注指标

pairs.english: They pay attention to the price action.
pairs.chinese: 他们关注价格行为

pairs.english: I’m Al Brooks.
pairs.chinese: 我是阿尔·布鲁克斯

pairs.english: Thank you for watching the Brooks Trading Course.
pairs.chinese: 感谢观看布鲁克斯交易课

pairs.english: This is the final video on chart basics and price action.
pairs.chinese: 图表基础和价格行为的最后一节课， 到这里就讲完了
